mcq_fix.s: Consider the following statements about colonial interpretations of caste: 1. Susan Bayly and Nicholas Dirks viewed caste as a colonial construct shaped by the Census. 2. The colonial Census began enumerating castes in 1871. 3. The Census had no role in shaping colonial understandings of caste. Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcq_fix.why: ranking castes by social precedence came with Risley's 1901 Census; 1871 only enumerated
